profileSub: What is already on your profile is marked ✓. Say what to change in words, or tap an item. "Not now" deletes nothing - you can bring it back.
error: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
conflict: The list changed meanwhile (maybe through your assistant) - this is the latest version.
updatedElsewhere: The list was updated elsewhere - this is the latest version.
lockedHint: Changing this row is a conversation with whoever answered - on the wish page.
sayPlaceholder: e.g. "design is right, drop Excel, add photography"

saved.profile: Saved to your profile. Your suggestions on the Lev page are updating.

keptAnswered: {{count}} rows you marked "not now" stayed, because a supplier answered a row after them.
publishOnSite: Publishing to the community is the wish's publish button.

nearby.title: Rikmas close to you
nearby.sub: They have no open mission that fits yet - but you can offer yourself, and the rikma decides.
